label: This DVD is invented. Its teaching is not.
It comes from real ministries' booklets and courses, 1987–2016.
Every reason in it was taught to real women.
You can stop it at any time.

admission.source: Emotional Dependency (IVP edition, 1990; first published by Exodus, 1987), printed p. 25 (NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F9, PDF p. 30)

admission.text: “…as painful as going through a divorce.”
admission.source: Emotional Dependency (1990), printed p. 25: "Letting go of a dependent relationship can be as painful as going through a divorce."

sentences.text: It asked women to end their closest friendships.
sentences.source: Emotional Dependency (1990), printed p. 24 ("A parting of the ways must take place"); p. 20 ("ties need to be broken with all past partners as well")

sentences.text: To throw away the songs they shared.
sentences.source: Emotional Dependency (1990), printed p. 25: "get rid of certain record albums or tapes (the ones containing 'our song')"

sentences.text: To confess their feelings, and be asked about them again and again.
sentences.source: Emotional Dependency (1990), printed p. 23: "hold us accountable, especially if we give him or her the freedom to periodically ask how things are going"

sentences.text: To look for the cause in their mothers and fathers.
sentences.source: Focus on the Family, The Heart of the Matter (2001), printed p. 14 ("the breakdown in a girl's initial relationship with her family—mother and father"); Exodus PR-02, Are People Born Gay? (1993), printed p. 8 (the father's "score card")

sentences.text: When the feelings stayed, it said they had not truly wanted to change.
sentences.source: Emotional Dependency (1990), printed p. 20: "this individual has no true interest in changing"

sentences.text: In June 2016 it was still sold in packs of five.
sentences.source: Exodus Global Alliance, "Women" resources page, archived 11 June 2016 (web.archive.org/web/20160611170337/http://www.exodusglobalalliance.org/forwomenp521.php), read 15 Nov 2026

text: 1. Look at the tree on page 22. What is in your soil?
2. Which of the Big Three do you recognise in your own story?
3. Pray for one another before you press play.
endOfPartOne.source: invented, in the grammar of a small-group DVD course's member workbook (Harvest USA, Sexual Sanity for Women, 2012: sessions with timed discussion blocks and questions; a DVD 'Leader's Edition with a discussion guide', Dove review of a 2014 video curriculum)
